text:
Aisha (CS Manager): quick check-in for NewCo — pulled the sparkline for last quarter vs last week. QoQ tokens +12%, but WoW down ~5%. noticing small latency blips on 2/18 that align with fallback to smaller model.
Ben S (Solutions Eng): got it. do you have the span for the latency blips? 95th pct or p99?
Aisha (CS Manager): p95 pushed from 210ms -> 380ms for a 3hr window; p99 saw one spike to 1.2s. error rate (5xx) up from 0.08% -> 0.23% during same window. seems tied to model routing fallback.
metrics-bot: automated summary: NewCo | QoQ tokens: +12% | WoW tokens: -4.8% | p95 latency median: 280ms | p95 during incident: 380ms | 5xx rate peak: 0.23% | avg cost/day: $1.2k | est monthly: $36k
Kai O (Onboarding): flagging that NewCo finished their multi-stage ingest on 2/16, so traffic pattern shifted. they started heavier batching for autocomplete tests. could explain QoQ uplift.
Ben S (Solutions Eng): thanks Kai. can we get the exact model variants used during the 3hr window? need to check quantization fallback maybe.
Aisha (CS Manager): yes — routing fell back from redwood-v2-std -> redwood-v2-lite for ~11k requests. that's the timing.
Ben S (Solutions Eng): sharing quick snippet of the query to filter:
```
SELECT ts, model_variant, tokens_in, latency_p95, error_rate
FROM metrics.requests
WHERE account_id='newco' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-18T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-02-18T05:00:00Z';
```
Kai O (Onboarding): next steps: schedule a 30-min enablement on batching knobs + prefix cache with NewCo. also suggest temporary increase to dedicated pool for peak windows.
Aisha (CS Manager): agree. action items: 1) Ben to validate fallback trigger thresholds + propose safer routing policy (due Tue EOD) 2) Kai to set enablement call and propose burst commit for two weeks (due Wed) 3) Ops to check cost impact if we keep dedicated burst (ops tagged as @infra-team)
Ben S (Solutions Eng): will validate thresholds. prelim thought: raise min warm replicas and tighten CPU metric that triggers fallback. low-risk change, test in staging then can roll.
Kai O (Onboarding): scheduled enablement: Thu 14:00 PT. I'll invite PM + infra contact at NewCo.
Aisha (CS Manager): on renewal risk: usage QoQ is healthy (+12%), but WoW dip and the latency spike increased support tickets. I'll mark as moderate risk until we close actions. recommend 1:1 with their engineering lead after enablement.
Ben S (Solutions Eng): note on spend: with current QoQ growth, estimated ARR motion is positive, but if latency persists churn risk grows. tagging finance for forecasting.
metrics-bot: note: next weekly snapshot will include model-variant breakout and cost-per-1000-token trend.
Aisha (CS Manager): thanks all — will follow up with a short notes doc and link to the dashboard. :thumbsup: any objections to pushing the routing change to canary after Ben's validation?
Ben S (Solutions Eng): no objections. will post test results in this thread when done.
Kai O (Onboarding): no objections. I'll prep the enablement deck focused on batching + cache examples.
Aisha (CS Manager): perfect — closing loop. tagging participants for visibility: @Ben S, @Kai O, @infra-team
